arStrings.szText:
Dealing damage with {c_important}Storm{/c} Skills, {c_important}Lightning Bolts{/c}, and {c_important}Dancing Bolts{/c} also applies an additional {c_number}{dot:POISONDOT}{/c} Poisoning damage over {c_number}{SF_5}{/c} seconds.

{c_label}Lucky Hit:{/c} Dealing Poison damage has up to a {c_number}[{SF_6}|%|]{/c} chance to summon a {c_important}Lightning Bolt{/c} on the target dealing {c_number}{payload:DAMAGE}{/c} damage.
